fee_notes: Standard Initial Fee is $25,000 for both Traditional and Non-Traditional Restaurants. Fee may be waived or reduced under certain circumstances, accepted in installments (interest-free, 1–18 months), or credited against development fees under a Multi-Unit Restaurant Agreement. During fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, fees collected ranged from $0 to $25,000 for a single restaurant. A separate Satellite fee of $15,000 per Satellite location also applies. Multi-Unit development fee is $25,000 multiplied by the number of restaurants to be opened, with the amount credited against per-unit Initial Fees.
raw_excerpt: If we grant you a franchise for a Traditional Restaurant, then when you sign the Franchise Agreement, you must pay us an initial franchise fee ("Initial Fee") of $25,000.  The Initial Fee for a Non-Traditional Restaurant is $25,000. ... During our fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, we collected Initial Fees ranging from $0 to $25,000 for a single restaurant.
